uniquesnotes.acquisition: Dropped by Waking Nightmare Prime Evil capstone bosses: Echo of Baal's Forces (Worldstone Keep, Fractured Peaks, T IV gate), Echo of Mephisto (Durance of Hate, Hawezar, T VI gate), Echo of Diablo (The Labyrinth, Scosglen, T VIII gate). Torment X+ fights are empowered (≈ T XII) and drop more consistently. Rarely from minor Nightmare bosses via Chronicle of Nightmares (from open-world WN portals, e.g. Helltides). Not item-specific — any boss can drop any of them. Echo of Pindleskin and the secret Uber Tristram event may drop any item. General world pool: plausible, unconfirmed. Exception — Godly Plate of the Whale: no confirmed source (no game8 page; not tied to fishing).
uniquesnotes.charms: 7 of 10 exist as (usually weaker) Talisman charm versions for cross-class access — e.g. Sorcerers/Spiritborn get In-Geom's effect via charm. Leoric's Crown and Messerschmidt's Reaver are items only. First mythic charm: Hellfire Torch (+1 charm slot), small chance whenever a Unique Charm drops; cannot be target-farmed.
uniquesnotes.mythicAcq: The 13 Iconic Mythics drop from ANY of the 12 Tormented lair bosses (Varshan, Grigoire, Beast in Ice, Lord Zir, Urivar, Duriel, Andariel, Harbinger, Butcher, Astaroth, Bartuc, Belial — no boss-specific pools; ~5 rolls × 1.5% baseline, buffed in 3.2.1). Standout source: Echo of Mephisto pinnacle boss (Crux of the False Prophet key) — GUARANTEED Mythic per kill (may roll a Mythic seal/charm instead). Also: Kurast Undercity Mythic Tribute of Armaments (cube: 5× Greater Tributes); Blacksmith 3× Resplendent Sparks → random Mythic; Jeweler 3 Sparks + 3×3 rune set → Mythic of that slot type. T I+ only, always 800 item power, max affixes, account-bound. Boss Trophy cube recipes produce Mythic VARIANTS of regular uniques only — not these.
uniquesnotes.universalAcq: Universal uniques: items with a 'dedicated boss' are target-farmable with Lair Keys and also appear in the General Unique Pool that any lair boss can drop. Items marked 'General Unique Pool' have no dedicated boss — any lair boss at lower odds, or convert a Common item of the same slot via the Horadric Cube 'Upgrade to Unique' recipe. 'World drop only' items have no boss table entry at all. Joke/cow items (Bell of the Bovine from Moophisto, the chicken set, Wilted Potential) sit outside both systems.
